selectedResponsibility.description: Design valid/minimal/full, invalid, boundary, auth and conditional sequence cases for each endpoint.

residualResponsibilities.description: Extract all endpoints, parameters, request/response constraints and auth; resolve ambiguity.
Emit independent parameterized tests in selected framework with fixtures and status/body/header assertions.
Summarize coverage, install/run instructions and gaps; each documented status and required field needs a test.
Resolve missing auth, errors, environment, side effects and framework preference.
Generate mock, k6 load or Pact output when requested.
Provide execution-platform link and offer follow-up API documentation.
